rate_upper_weeks.quote: one and a half weeks’ pay for a year of employment in which the employee was not below the age of forty-one

age_upper.quote: one and a half weeks’ pay for a year of employment in which the employee was not below the age of forty-one

rate_middle_weeks.quote: one week’s pay for a year of employment (not within paragraph (a)) in which he was not below the age of twenty-two

age_lower.quote: one week’s pay for a year of employment (not within paragraph (a)) in which he was not below the age of twenty-two

rate_lower_weeks.quote: half a week’s pay for each year of employment not within paragraph (a) or (b)

max_years.quote: Where twenty years of employment have been reckoned under subsection (1), no account shall be taken under that subsection
